import numpy as np

def pack_mesh(mesh):
    vertices, triangles = mesh
    return np.concatenate([
        np.array([vertices.shape[0], triangles.shape[0]], dtype=float),
        np.asarray(vertices, dtype=float).ravel(),
        np.asarray(triangles, dtype=float).ravel(),
    ])
assert np.allclose(pack_mesh(build_mesh(2, 2, refine=1)), target)

import numpy as np
import scipy.sparse as sp

B = sp.csr_matrix([
    [1., 0., -1.],
    [0., 1., -1.]
])

C = sp.csr_matrix([
    [1., 0.],
    [0., 1.]
])

Q = sp.csr_matrix([
    [2., 1.],
    [1., 2.]
])

def pack_condensed(data):
    return np.concatenate([
        np.asarray(data["Z"].toarray(), dtype=float).ravel(),
        np.asarray(data["Br"].toarray(), dtype=float).ravel(),
        np.asarray(data["Cr"].toarray(), dtype=float).ravel(),
    ])
assert np.allclose(pack_condensed(pressure_condense(B, C, Q)), target)

import numpy as np
import scipy.sparse as sp

B = sp.csr_matrix([[1., 2.]])
C = sp.csr_matrix([[1.]])
Q = sp.csr_matrix([[0.]])

def run_model():
    try:
        pressure_condense(B, C, Q)
        return 0
    except ValueError:
        return 1
    except Exception:
        return 2
assert np.allclose(run_model(), target)
